description:
Functional specifications/files: extend OAuth/runtime and nested workflow integration tests to assert effective Authorization at OpenAIStub across refresh, Actor propagation and nested Agents; add deterministic expiry HTTP evidence through existing lifecycle seams.
Tests first: old OAuth token request→refresh→delivered mutation→new token request; refresh failure never falls back globally; Alice/Bob/system workflow and nested calls assert outer/inner headers and opaque-scope isolation; stale expiry callback preserves current incarnation, matching expiry fences, expired cold start makes no request.
Branches: OAuth success/failure/revocation, nested configured agents, workflow Person/non-Person, stale/current expiry callbacks, expired grant.
Mocking: reuse Req.Test only for external OAuth token endpoint and OpenAIStub for external LLM; all ZAQ boundaries real. No production clock hook or sleeps; document that callback injection proves fencing rather than scheduler timing.
Docs: tests document entry-point parity; update service docs only for discovered drift.
Action reuse: not applicable — coverage reuses Connect.refresh_grant, workflow run_agent, Executor, ServerManager and existing external-edge mocks; adds no production operation, Action or tool.
title: OAuth workflow and nested Agent authentication HTTP coverage
